name: Chat — typing and sending a message shows a response

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://jaikrajokstudy.vercel.app/ and log in if prompted
Navigate to the แชท (chat) view via the sidebar
Click the message input field and type: สวัสดี
Press Enter or click the send button
The message สวัสดี appears in the chat history as a sent message (right-aligned or labeled as user)
Within 30 seconds a response message appears in the chat from the assistant (JaiKraJok)
